title: Yogurt Marinated Grill Chicken
seoTitle: Yogurt Marinated Grill Chicken | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Tender spiced chicken thighs from an overnight yogurt marinade
subtitle: Tender spiced chicken thighs from an overnight yogurt marinade
description: Chicken thighs marinate in Greek yogurt with lemon, garlic, and warm spices, then grill until charred outside and juicy inside.

steps.title: Mix marinade
steps.instruction: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, coriander, salt, pepper, and 2 tbsp oil until smooth and evenly spiced throughout.

steps.title: Marinate chicken
steps.instruction: Coat thighs thoroughly in marinade. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight so yogurt enzymes tenderize meat and flavors penetrate.

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.instruction: Heat grill to medium-high 400–450°F. Scrape and oil grates so chicken releases cleanly without tearing skin.

steps.title: Grill until done
steps.instruction: Grill skin-side down 6–7 minutes until charred. Flip, cook 8–10 more minutes until internal temp hits 165°F and juices run clear.

steps.title: Rest and garnish
steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes in foil. Scatter parsley. Meat should pull cleanly from bone with moist, white interior near bone.

proTips: Oven backup at 425°F works if rain cancels grill night—same marinade.
Serve with toum or tzatziki for cooling contrast.
Save marinade never—discard after raw chicken contact.
leftovers: Slice into wraps with yogurt sauce.
Chop over a grain bowl with pickled onions.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Yogurt tenderizes lean meat for foolproof grilling. Smoky char without drying out—ideal for summer hall nights.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate 4–24 hours. Bring to room temp 20 minutes before grilling. Station: Oil grill grates well—yogurt marinade sticks if grates are dry. Station: Grill skin-side down first for crisp char, finish flesh-side down. Station: Hold finished chicken in foil at 170°F max to prevent drying.
